key: Dsus2 – Bm7 – Gmaj7 – Asus4, D major nucleus resolution
direction: New score following all original musical sections, two full silence windows, instrument foley linked to the actual regenerated plate changes. No original soundtrack reused.

sections.intent: Bowed vibraphone and sparse mallet opening
Open pad, quarter pulse, glass dimension
Vibraphone eighths, marimba offbeats, two scans and measured landings
B-minor verdict impact, followed by open G major
Em9 dive, sixteenths, three objective clicks
D-major water-glass resolution and focal sweep
Silence then climb with six lighter clicks
Slower glass motif, bowed cymbal and low D
